purpose: Human-facing durable Home selector. Menu numbers are temporary aliases; durable continuation resolves to project_id and, when defined, chat_object_id.

selection_law.fresh_chat_prometeo: If no Chat Object/project is already bound and there is no recoverable materially-unsatisfied local intent, show this menu instead of guessing a workstream.
selection_law.numeric_selection: A bare menu number resolves through menu_order to a durable project_id and preferred chat_object_id when present, then loads recovery pointers and binds the disposable conversation.
selection_law.number_is_not_identity: Menu numbers may change. Never persist a number as identity.
selection_law.chat_is_disposable: A project/Chat Object must remain recoverable if the originating conversation disappears.
selection_law.unknown_project: If a registered project is not yet bound to exact durable Chat Object/workstreams, resolve using current runtime/catalog + aliases once, then persist the binding instead of asking the human to transport old chat context.
